title: Unknown user accessed claims database holding data of retired New York City employees
date_note: Published November 19; the article says the intrusion occurred on September 20 and periodically between October 5 and 8, and the notice letter is dated October 14.
geo_basis: affected city (victim firm's location not stated)
summary: Infobae, relaying Politico, says an unknown user accessed the claims database of Atticus Administration, which handles copayment refunds for retired New York City employees under an EmblemHealth settlement, exposing names, health and financial data of nearly 4,000 retirees. Atticus co-CEO Thomas Logan's letter said no payments were affected. Newser, also relaying Politico, says an EmblemHealth spokesperson stated no settlement money has been paid out.
plain: A firm that processes health-insurance refunds for retired New York City workers says an unknown person got into its claims database and saw names, health and financial details of nearly 4,000 retirees.
exec: Third-party administrator breach exposing health and financial data of public-sector retirees; shows supplier risk for insurers and city programs.
action: If you are an affected retiree, monitor refund and insurance statements for anything unexpected; insurers should review administrator access and refund-claim validation.
impact: Health and financial data of nearly 4,000 retirees exposed; Atticus told the settlement distributor no payment to claimants was created, modified or redirected.

evidence.quote: Hackers lograron acceder a los datos financieros y médicos de cerca de 4.000 empleados municipales jubilados de Nueva York

validation.note: Infobae and Newser both relay Politico's report on a confidential Atticus letter, so one origin; Politico's own page refused the automated reader (follow-up 22 Nov). No Atticus, EmblemHealth or city statement page read; Newser says Mayor Mamdani's office had not yet commented.

review.note: Compared with Infobae (relaying Politico): title, Sept 20 and Oct 5-8 dates, Oct 14 letter, nearly 4,000 retirees, data types, Logan co-CEO, unknown attacker all match. Fixed impact wording (no payment created, modified or redirected) and removed unsupported notification claim from action.
